objectives: Describe the order of the six days of creation, from the first light to mankind.
Explain why the day begins in the evening.
Explain who the man and the mankind of Genesis 1:26-27 are.
takeaways: The first light came before the sun, the moon and the stars, which were made on the fourth day (2 Esdras 6:38-40).
The day begins when it is dark and ends when it is dark (Genesis 1:5).
The firmament is the sky, dividing the waters below from the waters above.
Let them have dominion: the Most High did not create just one man; male and female created he them is mankind.
Everything He made was very good; He created everything for His own purpose.
